name: KGBpmnEvent
title: Knowledge graph L2-BPMN: BPMN Event
description: A start or end event. Same connectivity argument as gateway, plus one of its own: entry and exit points are what make 'is this task reachable' and 'does this path terminate' answerable at all. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-event.

element.definition: A start or end event. Same connectivity argument as gateway, plus one of its own: entry and exit points are what make 'is this task reachable' and 'does this path terminate' answerable at all. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-event.
The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
The BPMN event element type (startEvent, endEvent, intermediateCatchEvent, …).
